## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Bǎoníng Rényǒng* — a one-juan Northern-Sòng *yǔlù* of [Bǎoníng Rényǒng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%8B%87) 保寧仁勇, Línjì-Yángqí lineage master active at Bǎoníngsì 保寧寺. Compiled by his disciples [Dàowù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%8B%99) 道務 (*cānxué* 參學 student-disciple) and [Yuánjìng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%B7%A8) 圓淨 (*ménrén* 門人 formal disciple).

One-juan Northern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1350. Rényǒng's lifedates unrecorded; dharma-heir of [Yángqí Fānghuì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%B9%E6%9C%83) 楊岐方會 (992–1049), making him one of the founding figures of the Yángqí sub-lineage.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1060; *notAfter* c. 1100.
